snippet.title: Organ Failure - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
A turn-based surgery against a wacky plague doctor!
Extract organs, use items and attempt to cure your patients before your opponent does. Or kill them, idk, there's a lot of people in the world.

In English and Spanish!
